description:
InVitro Capital is looking for a passionate and hands\-on AI Engineer to join one of our high\-growth PortCos.
  
We’re seeking a hands\-on Senior AI Engineer to design, deploy, and scale production\-grade machine learning systems from the ground up.
  
You’ll work at the frontier of applied AI—training large\-scale models, building inference pipelines, and delivering business\-critical features for our high\-growth portfolio company.
  
**Work setup:** This is a hybrid role based in Cairo, with core working hours aligned to the Pacific Time Zone (Monday to Friday). Team members are expected to work from our Cairo office at least once a week for in\-person collaboration.
  
  

**Requirements:**  

Key Responsibilities
  
* Data Pipeline Engineering: Design and implement scalable data pipelines for model training and real\-time inference.
* Model Development: Build, fine\-tune, and integrate state\-of\-the\-art ML, NLP, and Computer Vision models using frameworks like TensorFlow, PyTorch, and Hugging Face Transformers.
* Model Deployment: Deploy AI models to production with a strong emphasis on performance, low latency, and reliability using Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud platforms such as AWS and GCP.
* Cross\-functional Collaboration: Work closely with product, backend, and infrastructure teams to deliver full\-stack ML solutions, including APIs, microservices, and streaming inference systems.
* Model Monitoring \& Optimization: Continuously track and improve model performance, accuracy, scalability, and system stability in live environments.


Minimum Qualifications
  
* 7–10\+ years of experience building and deploying ML/AI systems in production environments.
* Strong understanding of machine learning, deep learning, and data engineering best practices.
* Hands\-on experience with LLMs, computer vision, or recommender systems.
* Proficient in Python, with experience using PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar.
* Familiar with MLOps best practices, CI/CD, and microservice architecture.


Preferred Qualifications
  
* Experience building real\-time ML systems (e.g., streaming inference, edge/on\-device ML).
* Familiarity with observability and monitoring tools (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana).
* Active contributor to open\-source ML/AI projects or strong GitHub presence.


**Benefits:**  

* Work on cutting\-edge AI and B2B technologies: We are at the forefront of AI and B2B innovation. Our employees have the opportunity to work on the latest and greatest technologies, and to make a real impact on the SME market.
* Help build and grow successful startups: We are committed to helping our portfolio companies succeed. Our employees play a vital role in building and growing these companies. This is not a 9 to 5 job. This is a startup environment with a give\-it\-all mentality.
* Work with some of the best minds in the industry: You will be part of a team of seasoned entrepreneurs and product leaders who are on a mission to make a difference in the SME space. You will have the chance to work with some of the best minds in the industry.
* Supportive and collaborative work environment: We believe in creating a supportive and collaborative work environment where our employees can thrive.

To achieve this, we are developing a holistic healthcare approach that combines medical excellence on site with the advantages of digital solutions. At the heart of our strategy is a **hybrid care concept** that integrates modern general practitioner practices with innovative digital tools.

Bei Vantis stehen wir an vorderster Front der medizinischen Innovation. Mit einem starken Fokus auf Technologie und chronischen Krankheiten arbeiten wir daran, die traditionelle Gesundheitsversorgung radikal zu verbessern.

 At Allianz Global Investors we foster a culture of professionalism, fulfilment, and an inclusive working environment. Do you want to be part of a leading active asset management company? Then join us now!
   

  

 As the Senior AI Software Engineer (f/m/d) in the team, you will be primarily responsible for the design and development of full\-stack Generative AI (GenAI) and Machine Learning (ML) applications for a wide range of use cases in the Asset Management space. This role works closely with domain experts to understand business needs and translate them into technical requirements for development.
   

  

 By leveraging Generative AI, you will take a technical leadership role in driving the development of innovative solutions and providing technical guidance to the development team where necessary. Within a central AI team in collaboration with other engineers \& architects, the Sr. AI Software Engineer (f/m/d) leads the development of prototypes to assess technology readiness and suitability for specific applications, ultimately guiding the scaling of the most promising prototypes into production\-ready applications and platforms.
   

  

 A secondary part of the role is to develop AI engineering capability to meet the growing demand for AI. This involves researching new technologies, defining technical standards, rolling out templates, frameworks \& best practices such as LLMOps/MLOps together with its enablement across the organization via developer communities and outreach initiatives.
   

  

 This position will be based in Frankfurt or Munich.
   

  

**What You Will Do**
* Provide technical leadership by defining and sharing engineering best practices such as MLOps/LLMOps and ensuring company policies/procedures are adhered to for the AI solutions the team manages
* Mentor \& co\-ordinate activities of junior AI engineers
* Development of full\-stack solutions for GenAI/ML applications, integrating both frontend and backend components to deliver robust and scalable solutions
* Work closely with cross\-functional teams to understand business requirements and translate these into technical requirements for application development
* Ideation and development of solutions and co\-creation with development teams to transition prototypes into production where viable
* AI enablement and upskilling within AllianzGI through consultations, training, and communities with engineers, citizen developers, etc.
* Share best practices and content around AI Engineering and AI in general, with the objective of accelerating the adoption of AI across the company
* Champion responsible, secure, and compliant AI
* Work with and make recommendations to leadership teams regarding AI strategy, roadmap, and buy\-versus\-build decisions
* Research and share the latest industry trends and technologies to help foster AllianzGI relevant innovation and business transformation


**What You Bring**
**Education**
* University degree or equivalent in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, Machine Learning, Data Science or related fields


**Experience**
* A minimum of ten (10\) years’ experience in full stack application development is required
* Ideally industry experience in Investment Banking/Asset Management
* A minimum of three (3\) years’ industry experience in GenAI and ML based App development
* A minimum of three (3\) years’ experience working with agile teams, required


**Knowledge \& Hardskills**
* Proficiency in Python, including experience with libraries and frameworks relevant to ML and GenAI application development (e.g., LangChain, FastAPI, Semantic Kernel, and AutoGen)
* Detailed understanding and hands\-on experience with large language models (LLMs), AI agents, retrieval\-augmented generation (RAG) architecture, embedding techniques, prompt engineering, fine\-tuning, multi\-choice prompts (MCPs), LLMOps, MLOps, vibecoding, and reinforcement learning
* Experience with modern web development frameworks and languages, including React, TypeScript, and Node.js, with a background in building and maintaining both front\-end and back\-end applications
* Experience working with production\-grade vector databases (e.g., Azure AI Search, MongoDB, Cosmos DB, pgvector, Chroma, or Milvus) for efficient storage and retrieval of embeddings
* Ideally experienced with container technologies (Docker, Kubernetes) and Cloud native services in Azure
* Experience with relational databases (e.g., SQL Server, MySQL, PostgreSQL)
* Experience with Agile development and DevOps practices using tools such as Harness, GitHub, JFrog, Jira, and Datadog
* Ability to create unit tests, integration tests using common testing frameworks (e.g., pytest, Playwright)
* Ideally knowledge and strong understanding of component\-based architecture, state management and intuitive UX design principles


**Softskills**
* Well\-developed interpersonal skills with the ability to interact effectively at all organizational levels, coupled with excellent English communication
* Ability to translate and drive conceptual ideas to technical requirements for application development
* Strong analytical skills, and a creative mindset to effectively define problems and explore solutions
* Ability to understand technical problems presented by non\-technical users and communicate technical solutions in a clear, non\-technical manner
* Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with a strong customer\-service focus
* Strong organizational skills to manage time efficiently, prioritize tasks, and meet multiple deadlines


**What We Offer**
* We empower our employees by ensuring flexible work arrangements that maintain a balance between performance, productivity, career development and personal priorities (e.g., hybrid model/ flexible working hours)
* Securing your future: Access to company pension/savings plans
* Family support (relocation/ childcare facilities)
* Company share purchasing plan
* Mental health and wellbeing programs
* Mobility solutions (Jobrad bike leasing, subvention Jobticket)
* Career opportunities within the entire Allianz Group
* Self\-guided learning \& development
* … and so much more!


**About Allianz Global Investors**
 Allianz Global Investors is a leading global active asset manager.
   

  

 We invest for the long term and want to create value for clients every step of the way. We do this by being active – in how we partner with clients and anticipate their needs, and build solutions based on capabilities across public and private markets. Our focus on enhancing our clients’ assets leads naturally to a commitment to sustainability for positive change. Our goal is to enhance the investment experience for clients, whatever their location or goals.
   

  

 Putting our clients' needs first, behaving in a transparent way and treating people fairly means acting with integrity. We encourage a collegial culture, that supports individual responsibility. We invest in the development of our employees to maximize the power of innovation.
   

  

 We at Allianz believe in a diverse and inclusive workforce, we are committed to the principles of Equal Employment Opportunity and to helping applicants with any disabilities. We encourage you to bring your whole self to work, no matter where you are from, what you look like, who you love or what you believe in. We therefore welcome applications regardless of ethnicity or cultural background, age, gender, nationality, religion, disability or sexual orientation. Great to have you on board.
   

  

 If you feel inspired to promote the active asset management experience, this is the place for you. Join our diverse, international, technology\-enabled, and agile environment. Simply upload your CV in English to apply for this position! If you need support to navigate our websites or at any stage during your application, please send an email with your request to recruiting@allianzgi.com
   

  

**To Recruitment Agencies**
 Allianz Global Investors has an in\-house recruitment team that sources great candidates directly. Therefore, Allianz Global Investors does not accept unsolicited resumes from agency or search firm recruiters.
   

  

 When we do work with recruitment agencies, that engagement is formalized by a contract. Fees will only be paid when there is a contract in place.
   

  

 Without a contract in place, we will not accept invoices on unsolicited resumes, even if the candidate was ultimately employed by Allianz Global Investors.
   

  

 Finally, please do not contact hiring managers directly.

title: IBM Tech Sales Accelerator Program: Client Engineering - Data (f/m/x)
description:
**Introduction**
 Are you looking to kick\-start your career in technology with a structured development path and fast\-track growth opportunities? Our IBM Tech Sales Accelerator Program is designed for ambitious graduates, offering hands\-on training ( Data, Business Automation, Security, AI, Assistants), mentorship, and real\-world experience within IBM Client Engineering. Over 12\-24 months, you will work in Client Engineering before transitioning into your next career step as Data Technical Sales Engineer.
   

  

**Your Role And Responsibilities**
 As a Data Technical Sales Engineer you'll work closely with clients and partners to develop relationships, understand their needs, earn their trust and show them how IBM's industry leading solutions will solve their problems whilst delivering value to their business. Your primary responsibilities will include:
   

  

* Client Management and Strategy: Manage a dedicated client set and define, confirm and communicate the value of IBM’s Data technology at both the technical and business level.
* Solution Definition and Proof of Concept Delivery: Learn and employ Data solution\-selling techniques to identify and engage decision makers and influencers, qualify business opportunities, and respond to clients' needs. Provide proof of concepts and simplifying technical concepts of Data to ensure client comprehension.
* Credibility Building and Trust: Establish credibility and trust with clients, which is essential for closing complex technology deals.
* Sales Process Management: Manage the entire sales process and ensure delivery against KPIs, with a strong emphasis on new business sales, while expanding existing accounts.


 As part of your IBM Tech Sales Accelerator Program, you will start in Client Engineering as AI Engineer, developing trusted relationships, you’ll work with clients and colleagues to shape the future of their technology landscape, creating (2 \- 4 week) pilots for clients, and contributing to IBM’s story of growth and technology innovation. As we help you combine your technical education with consultative sales best practices, you will accelerate enterprises’ success.
   

  

**Your Responsibilities In Client Engineering Include**
* Pilot Development: Develop pilots to validate and highlight the feasibility and effectiveness of proposed AI solutions. Collaborate with development teams to implement and iterate on pilots, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and expectations. This follows IBM Client Engineering’s Pilot Engineering Method, a human\- and design\-led approach that solves complex business problems with transformative technology. Using our proven co\-creation methodology, we align our experts with key client stakeholders to identify challenges and build Proof of Experiences (PoXs) that ‘de\-risk’ these challenges using IBM hybrid cloud and AI technology.
* Collaboration and Project Management: Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including AI engineers, platform engineers, and project managers, to ensure smooth execution and successful delivery of AI and Automation solutions. Effectively communicate project progress, risks, and dependencies to stakeholders.
* Customer Engagement and Support: Act as a technical point of contact for customers, addressing their questions, concerns, and feedback. Provide technical support during the pilot deployment phase and offer guidance on best practices for scaling pilots into production.
* Industry Trends and Innovation: Stay up to date with the latest trends and advancements. Evaluate emerging technologies, tools, and frameworks to assess their potential impact on solution design and implementation.


**Required Technical And Professional Expertise**
 Technical Education: Completed technical degree such as Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.
   

  

 Communication and Language Skills: Possess excellent communication and presentation skills that are engaging, compelling and influential. English \& Local Language proficiency requested.
   

  

 Analytical Skills with a focus on using data for decision\-making and achieving positive business outcomes.
   

  

 Team player with a collaborative spirit, able to work across multiple functions and levels within IBM and partners.
   

  

**Preferred Technical And Professional Experience**
 First experience with Sales and/or IT.
   

  

 IBM is seeking a dynamic, enthusiastic, and results\-oriented individual with a profound passion for Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Data. This role requires a blend of hunting for new business opportunities and nurturing existing client relationships, specializing in IBM’s solutions portfolio.

* Ability to understand technical problems presented by non\-technical users and communicate technical solutions in a clear, non\-technical manner
* Proven ability to work collaboratively in a team environment with a strong customer\-service focus

 As part of your IBM Tech Sales Accelerator Program, you will start in Client Engineering as AI Engineer, developing trusted relationships, you’ll work with clients and colleagues to shape the future of their technology landscape, creating (2 \- 4 week) pilots for clients, and contributing to IBM’s story of growth and technology innovation. As we help you combine your technical education with consultative sales best practices, you will accelerate enterprises’ success.

Collaborate with development teams to implement and iterate on pilots, ensuring alignment with customer requirements and expectations.  First experience with Sales and/or IT.

title: Principal AI Engineer
description:
**Company Description**
 We are SGS – the world's leading testing, inspection and certification company. Today, that mission is driven by data. With 99,500 employees across 2,500 locations, we generate a unique and massive dataset on global trade, product quality, and sustainability. We are now launching a new Hub in Madrid to turn that data into intelligent products and services. This is your opportunity to build the intelligence layer that will redefine our industry.
   

  

**Job Description**
 We're looking for a pioneer to tackle the next frontier: building intelligent agents that can reason and act using one of the world's most unique industrial data sets. This is a greenfield role where you won’t just fine\-tune models – you’ll build the entire Gen AI – native foundation for a global leader, with the executive backing and autonomy to make it happen.
   

  

 As SGS’s founding Principal AI Engineer, your mission is to lead the charge in applying cutting\-edge Generative AI to solve our most complex business challenges. You will be a hands\-on builder, crafting everything from custom fine\-tuned LLMs to sophisticated agentic workflows that automate and augment expert tasks. You will move fast, ship impactful product, and set the standard for practical, value driven AI.
   

  

**What You'll Build And Own**
* Pioneer Generative AI Solutions: Lead the design and hands\-on development of our most advanced AI initiatives, focusing on LLMs, Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG), and multi\-step agentic systems.
* Build \& Fine\-Tune Models: Go beyond off\-the\-shelf APIs. You will fine\-tune open\-source models (e.g., Llama, Mistral) on our proprietary data to create highly specialized, defensible AI capabilities.
* Engineer Agentic Workflows: Architect and build systems where AI agents can use tools, call functions, and interact with other systems to execute complex, real\-world tasks like analyzing inspection reports or drafting compliance documentation.
* Own the Pragmatic AI Stack: Select, implement, and champion a lean, effective AI/ML stack (e.g., LangChain/LlamaIndex, vector databases, modern MLOps tools) that prioritizes speed and developer velocity.
* Collaborate \& Scale: Partner with other engineering teams to package your breakthroughs into reusable patterns and services, acting as a force multiplier for AI adoption across the company.
* Establish the AI Vision: As the foundational AI expert, you will be a thought leader, shaping our technical strategy and mentoring the team that will form around your vision.


**Qualifications**
* Generative AI \& LLMs: Deep, hands\-on experience building applications with LLMs. This includes prompt engineering, RAG architecture, fine\-tuning, and evaluating model performance.
* AI Agent \& Workflow Development: Proven experience with frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, or building custom agentic systems. Understanding of concepts like ReAct, function calling, and planning.
* Core ML \& Python: Expert\-level Python and a strong foundation in classical ML and deep learning (PyTorch preferred).
* AI Infrastructure: Hands\-on experience with vector databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate, Chroma), containerization (Docker, Kubernetes), and cloud AI services (GCP Vertex AI, AWS Bedrock/SageMaker).
* Data \& APIs: Ability to process unstructured data, build robust data pipelines for model training, and expose models via high\-performance APIs (e.g., using FastAPI).


**Who You Are**
* You are a builder at heart, with extensive experience (e.g., 8\+ years) in AI/ML and a recent, intense focus on the LLM space.
* You are obsessed with shipping real products, not just publishing papers.
* You thrive in a fast\-paced, high\-autonomy environment and are comfortable with ambiguity.
* You are a pragmatist who chooses the right tool for the job, whether it's a simple script or a complex distributed system.


**Additional Information**
**What We Offer**
* Top\-of\-Market Compensation: A highly competitive salary and bonus package for Madrid, designed to attract and retain premier talent for this strategic role.
* Greenfield Ownership \& Autonomy: This is not an R\&D role with no path to production. You have a mandate to build and ship, with the freedom to choose your stack, backed by C\-level sponsorship.
* Foundational Impact: You will be the first Principal AI Engineer in our new Digital Hub, shaping the technology, culture, and future of AI at a global leader.
* A Unique Problem Space: Apply cutting\-edge AI to one\-of\-a\-kind datasets from global supply chains, materials science, and industrial testing. This is your chance to solve tangible problems that few others can.
* A Clear Growth Path: This role offers a direct path to technical leadership and the opportunity to build and mentor a team around your architectural vision.

* Are able to think analytically and creatively, especially in applying technology solutions to core business problems
* Are focused on creating and adding value for customers
* Have an entrepreneurial mindset and the ability to multi\-task, prioritize and execute
* Are able to build relationships with senior management and influence decision\-makers
* Are confident to present to C\-level executives and larger audiences
* Are willing to travel to the UK region to meet clients in person
* Are an effective communicator and fluent in English.

* Accelerate Your Growth: Benefit from clear career paths, internal mobility, a dedicated learning program, and mentorship opportunities.
* Receive Exceptional Benefits: Including generous PTO, hybrid working options, company equity (RSUs), comprehensive benefits, extensive parental leave, dedicated volunteer days, and much more. Interns and working students explore your benefits here.

* Empowered Environment: Contribute your ideas in an open culture with autonomous teams.

It’s system\-agnostic and without bias, and provides everyone with a common language for understanding and improving businesses. * Has at least 2\-4 years of backend development experience in Python, especially in startups or tech companies.

title: AI Engineer
description:
**Role:** AI Engineer (Enterprise Agentic AI Systems)

**Location:** London Bridge, London, UK

**Work Setup:** Hybrid (3 days/week in office \- Tues, Weds, Thurs)

**Type:** Full\-time, Permanent

**Seniority:** Mid to Senior Level

**Start Date:** ASAP (flexible for the right person)

**The Mission**

We’re building the next generation of intelligent systems that help businesses understand and act on what matters \- faster, deeper, and at scale.

Our platform brings together enterprise data, powerful language models, and agentic workflows to unlock new levels of insight and decision\-making. We believe the future of AI isn’t just about answering questions \- it’s about designing systems that can reason, plan, and take meaningful action in the real world.

This is your chance to help shape that future.

**The Role**

As an AI Engineer, you’ll help define the core intelligence behind our agentic platform \- designing systems that enable AI to interact meaningfully with complex business environments.

You’ll work at the intersection of natural language processing, data systems, and applied reasoning \- helping shape how our agents interpret context, generate insight, and act. This isn’t prompt engineering, nor is this automation at scale. This is building infrastructure that allows AI to operate inside real businesses and deliver impact autonomously.

You’ll join early enough to shape the architecture, tooling, and direction of the platform \- and with the support of a team that’s already moving fast. Expect ambiguity, ownership, and the opportunity to influence how AI gets built for real\-world decision\-making.

This is a role for a systems\-minded, product\-aware builder \- someone who sees around corners, enjoys unsolved problems, and wants to help define what AI can do when deeply embedded in business operations.

**What You’ll Do**

* Design and deploy intelligent agent workflows that operate on real\-time business data
* Build the core orchestration layer that powers agent reasoning, memory, and decision logic
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to define agent tools and data interaction patterns
* Develop backend systems and services that securely connect agents to enterprise data sources
* Implement workflows that enable agents to deliver insight and take follow\-up action
* Define evaluation frameworks to measure agent performance, accuracy, and reliability
* Own the full lifecycle of agent development \- from design and testing to deployment and iteration

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3\+ years experience in software/AI/data engineering, with a background in backend, data, or ML systems
* Strong proficiency in Python and a focus on clean, testable, modular code
* Experience with SQL and Python data libraries (e.g. Pandas, Polars)
* Exposure to LLM application patterns (e.g. tool use, memory, retrieval, orchestration)
* Curiosity and excitement about Agentic AI systems \- not just using models, but designing how they think and act
* Solid software engineering fundamentals, including API design and backend service architecture
* Comfort in navigating ambiguity and building in fast\-moving environments
* Bonus: experience with RAG, vector databases, embeddings, or intelligent orchestration frameworks (e.g. ADK, LangChain, Haystack)

**Why Join Us**

* Be an important member of a team where AI agents are THE product, not a feature
* Help build the next enterprise stack that turns data into insight and action
* Collaborate with a no\-ego, fast\-moving team that values curiosity and ownership
* Shape the future of decision\-making in real, enterprise business, across multiple verticals
* Be a fundamental part of the new category of Enterprise AI

If you're interested and think you'd be a great fit we'd love to here from you!

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: £60,000\.00\-£80,000\.00 per year

* Are you comfortable working in a Hybrid setting (Tues, Weds, Thurs)?
* When can you start (in months \- ASAP for immediate)?

Experience:

* commercial (outside of academia): 2 years (required)

Work authorisation:

* United Kingdom (required)

Work Location: Hybrid remote in London SE1 9SE

description:
Our customer is looking for a Data and AI Engineer in the defence sector.
  
  

**Role:**  

Undertake stocktake of current AI initiatives across Engineering UK including assessment of customer tools and infrastructure already available to determine suitability of applications for executing Systems Engineering identified use\-cases.
  
  

In doing so, ensure engagement of stakeholders involved in the following activities:
  
  

* External paper / conference / internet assessment of use of AI in the context of Systems Engineering and MBSE specifically to determine if any other suitable tools currently not employed by the customer are available.
* Undertake Proof of Concept investigations to perform the selected use cases. This will be the main activity and may involve exploitation of tools and infrastructure already within the customer, or may involve the testing of a third party tool. Use Cases are:
* Using Generative AI to produce Design Verification Plans (DVPs)
* AI Generated Reference Requirements
* Identification of Challenging Customer and Project Requirements
* Proof of concept activities include:
* Define scope of engineering data \- expectation is to start with systems artefacts (Requirements, Test Results other supporting documentation as appropriate)
* Scope engineering data model approach and capture mechanism in more detail
* Undertake incremental definition, development and review of NLP Generative AI engineering data model as proof of concept, initially tailored to specific Systems Engineering use cases.
* Ensure underlying data model compliance with customer IM and InfoSec policies.
* Formalise, establish governance, deploy such that the proof of concept can be used practically to derive harmonisation and consistency into programmes in areas such as requirement definition and Verification \& Validation activities.
* Data Model Conclusion/Review and Decision to proceed to full deployment


**Outputs:**  

* Requirements (if external solution) or outline design solution (if internal solution) to be fulfilled by candidate AI solutions.
* Down\-select decision review to determine most appropriate toolsets to employ to realise Systems Engineering Use Cases follow internal/external tool assessment.
* Deployment plan and pilot project deployment strategy for implementation of a Generative AI solution using natural language processing (NLP).
* Incremental delivery of engineering data model \- output at end of offload initial 6 month contract should cover systems engineering use cases as identified above.
* Report to summarise delivery of the above – Toolset Capability Assessment, Generative AI Requirements, Down\-select Justification, Summary of PoC data model design and deployment activities.


COMPETITIVE RATES OUTSIDE IR\-35
  
  

**Requirements:**  

**Skills:**  

* A strong understanding of the concepts, benefits, ontology, taxonomy and applications of AI.
* Experience of exploring and deploying AI to support productivity improvements in the engineering domain would be an advantage.
* Good experience of container management and orchestration platforms to deploy, scale and manage containerised applications is required. Direct experience of Rancher, Kubernetes or Docker would be beneficial.
* Experience of data manipulation and visualisation techniques such as Power BI or Google Analytics’ Looker Studio.
* AI tool development skills are not necessary but some ability to code APIs to interact with Large Language Models using Python / R or other languages is required.
* A strong engineering background, ideally with experience in systems engineering. Defence engineering experience is desirable.
* Ability to work autonomously and comfortable with loosely defined packages of work with low levels of supervision.

title: Senior Software Engineer II - AI Engineer
description:
Senior Software Engineer II \- AI Engineer
About the team:
Our team is dedicated to unlocking the rich knowledge embedded within Elsevier’s content through our semantic data platform; this empowers researchers, clinicians, and innovators worldwide to gain new insights, make informed decisions, and accelerate progress across research, healthcare, and life sciences. We lead the ongoing transformation of Elsevier’s vast, unstructured information into richly interconnected knowledge graphs that capture the full depth and nuance of scientific meaning.
Through our dynamic knowledge discovery platform, we combine graph\-powered agentic AI with advanced search \& retrieval technologies to deliver contextually relevant, trustworthy, and precise answers to users.
As part of this mission, the AI Engineering team is focused on building reusable generative AI capabilities that can be embedded across products and platforms. We create scalable, secure, and production\-ready AI services — enabling downstream teams to integrate cutting\-edge GenAI features with confidence.
About the role:
We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer II with a passion for generative AI and platform architecture. In this role, you will design and implement robust systems to deliver reusable AI services and components, collaborating closely with cross\-functional stakeholders to solve meaningful challenges. You will also contribute to architectural decisions, mentor other engineers, and help evolve our engineering practices.
Key responsibilities:* Designing, developing, and maintaining generative AI services and reusable components using Python and Java.
* Deploying scalable applications in a Kubernetes (EKS) environment.
* Contributing to system architecture and design across multiple services.
* Collaborating with product, platform, and research teams to translate AI prototypes into production\-ready solutions.
* Building and optimizing CI/CD pipelines and apply test\-driven development practices.
* Troubleshooting and resolving complex technical challenges in distributed systems.
* Supporting and mentoring team members, sharing knowledge and best practices.
* Participating in code reviews and architecture discussions to ensure quality and maintainability.
* Stay current with developments in generative AI and promote responsible integration into products.


Requirements:* Good experience in software engineering (formal education not required).
* Proficiency in Python and Java.
* Experience with Kubernetes (EKS) and cloud\-native systems.
* Strong background in building scalable backend systems and APIs.
* Familiarity with generative AI tools (e.g., HuggingFace, LangChain, vector databases).
* Understanding of software development methodologies and data modelling.
* Experience mentoring others and contributing to technical decisions.
* Ability to work effectively in Agile or Kanban environments.


Why join us?
Are you ready to help us progress science and health? Our technology leads to innovation, so join a forward\-thinking digital business that is tackling world\-scale challenges and align your ambitions with our passion for driving global knowledge\-sharing.
Work in a way that works for you
We promote a healthy work/life balance across the organization. We offer an appealing working prospect for our people. With numerous wellbeing initiatives, shared parental leave, study assistance and sabbaticals, we will help you meet your immediate responsibilities and your long\-term goals.* Flexible hours \- flex the times when you work in the day to help you fit everything in and work when you are the most productive.

We know that your well\-being and happiness are key to a long and successful career. These are some of the benefits we are delighted to offer:* Generous holiday allowance with the option to buy additional days.
* Health screening, eye care vouchers and private medical benefits.
* Wellbeing programs.
* Life assurance.
* Access to a competitive contributory pension scheme.
* Long service awards.
* Save As You Earn share option scheme.
* Travel Season ticket loan.
* Maternity, paternity, and shared parental leave.
* Access to emergency care for both the elderly and children.
* RECARES days, giving you time to support the charities and causes that matter to you.
* Access to employee resource groups with dedicated time to volunteer.
* Access to extensive learning and development resources.
* Access to employee discounts via Perks at Work.

A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. At Elsevier, your work contributes to the world’s grand challenges and a more sustainable future. We harness innovative technologies to support science and healthcare to partner for a better world.

title: AI Engineer
description:
### **About Us:**



Hive Perform is revolutionising how sales teams win deals. We're the AI\-native platform bridging the gap between revenue intelligence and sales training for scaling businesses – trusted by over 10,000 employees at leading companies.



We don't just show you what happened; we show you what to do next. Our science\-based analysis framework gives complete deal visibility, tracks strategy execution, and guides reps on exact next steps to close more deals.



As a business backed by Blenheim Chalcot, a world\-leading venture builder, you'll join a network of organisations at the cutting edge of AI and innovation.



If you're passionate about applying AI to solve real revenue challenges and want to make a meaningful impact at a growing startup, we'd love to hear from you. We're seeking a talented AI Engineer to join our mission of transforming how businesses win deals.


### **The Role:**



Join our engineering team as we build intelligent systems that power deal\-winning strategies for ambitious companies.



You'll be working on challenging problems in sales intelligence: predicting deal outcomes, automatically surfacing actions that move deals forward, and turning sales data into strategic insights that drive revenue.



In our fast\-paced environment, you'll take ownership of meaningful AI projects from day one, work closely with our founding team, and see your code impact real businesses within weeks.


### **What You'll Be Building:**



AI Sales Intelligence:


* Develop AI agents that predict deal outcomes and identify revenue risks before they become problems
* Build intelligent coaching systems that automatically surface personalised next\-best\-actions for sales reps
* Build intelligent automation that helps sales teams execute their playbooks with unprecedented consistency
* Create advanced analytics engines that transform sales conversations into strategic insights


Production\-Scale AI Infrastructure:


* Architect ML pipelines that process millions of sales interactions in real\-time
* Build robust data quality frameworks ensuring our AI insights are always accurate and actionable
* Implement RAG systems and vector search capabilities for intelligent content discovery and recommendation


Scalable ML Operations:


* Deploy models using modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes) that scale with our rapidly growing customer base
* Build comprehensive evaluation pipelines ensuring our AI performs reliably in high\-stakes sales environments
* Create monitoring and alerting systems that keep our AI running smoothly 24/7

### **The Impact You'll Make:**


* **Week 1\-4:** Ship your first AI feature that helps sales reps close more deals
* **Month 3:** Utilise LLMs for processing of real sales data for major enterprise clients
* **Month 6:** Lead the development of a major AI capability that transforms how our customers win business
* **Year 1:** Become a key technical contributor shaping the future of sales AI

### **What Makes You Perfect for This Role:**



Technical Excellence:


* Recent MSc/MEng in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field with strong academic performance
* Hands\-on experience with Python
* Experience with LLMs and their APIs
* Experience building end\-to\-end ML systems from data processing to production deployment


Additional:


* Hands\-on experience with PyTorch, transformers, and modern ML frameworks
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS preferred), Docker, Kubernetes, and MLOps practices


Real\-World AI Experience:


* Previous internship or project experience applying GenAI, LLMs, and prompt engineering to solve business problems
* Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and intelligent search capabilities
* Understanding of production ML challenges: data quality, model monitoring, and scalable deployment


Sales \& Business Acumen:


* Genuine interest in understanding sales processes and revenue optimisation (we'll teach you the rest!)
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate business requirements into technical AI solutions
* Experience conducting user research or working directly with end\-users of AI systems


Startup DNA:


* Thrive in fast\-paced environments where you can ship code that immediately impacts real businesses
* Self\-motivated and able to take ownership of complex technical challenges
* Growth mindset with eagerness to learn about sales, business strategy, and emerging AI technologies
* Collaborative team player who can work effectively with product, design, and go\-to\-market teams

### **Why You'll Love Working Here:**



Strong Growth Opportunity:


* Work closely with our founding team and contribute to the technical direction of a scaling startup
* Take ownership of AI initiatives that directly impact our core product and customer success
* Accelerate your career in the growing field of revenue intelligence


Modern Technology:


* Work with the latest advances in GenAI, LLMs, and production ML systems
* Access to quality infrastructure and comprehensive learning resources
* Mentorship from experienced engineers and exposure to enterprise\-scale challenges


Direct Impact:


* Your work directly helps sales teams improve their performance and grow their businesses
* See the immediate impact of your contributions on real customers and their outcomes
* Contribute to building a leading platform for sales AI


Amazing Benefits \& Culture:


* Competitive salary
* 25 days annual leave \+ bank holidays and your birthday off
* Life assurance (3x annual salary) and pension scheme
* Up to £900 flexible benefits: medical insurance, dental, gym membership, and more
* Be part of the Blenheim Chalcot family – connect with incredible people across 30\+ startups
* Regular social events and networking opportunities at Scale Space

### **Our Values:**


* **Experts, but not always right** \- We bring deep expertise while staying humble and open to new approaches
* **Substance before "sizzle"** \- We build robust, impactful AI that solves real problems, not just impressive demos
* **Caring and courageous** \- We support each other's growth and tackle the hardest technical challenges in sales AI
* **Evergreen entrepreneurs** \- We think like owners and continuously innovate to stay ahead
* We care deeply about giving feedback in the right way. We champion the idea of test and learn, and we're not afraid of failure. We're always looking for ways to improve, and respect everyone's ideas. And we really take the time to invest in our working relationships, and overall, practise what we preach.

### **This Role Might Not Be For You If...**


* You prefer slow\-moving, bureaucratic environments (we ship fast and iterate quickly)
* You want to work on AI for AI's sake rather than solving real business problems
* You're not excited about learning the sales domain and working closely with go\-to\-market teams
* You're uncomfortable with the ambiguity and rapid change that comes with cutting\-edge AI development

### **Join Our Team:**



We're looking for our next AI engineer to help build the future of revenue intelligence. If you're ready to apply your AI skills to solve challenging problems in sales and business growth, we want to hear from you.


**Right to Work:** Please note that all candidates must have the right to work in the UK by the start of their employment. We are unable to sponsor a work visa for this role.


*We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Hive Perform is committed to building an inclusive, diverse team where everyone can do their best work. We don't tolerate discrimination and actively work to create a supportive environment for all.*


By submitting your CV you understand that we have a legitimate interest to use your personal data for the purposes of assessing your eligibility for this role. This means that we may use your personal data to contact you to discuss your CV or arrange an interview, or transfer your CV to the hiring manager(s) of the role you have applied for. You can ask us at any time to remove your CV from our database by emailing recruitment@blenheimchalcot.com – but please note that this means we will no longer consider you for the role you have applied for. You can review our privacy policy here.

**About Us**
 Hive Perform is revolutionising how sales teams win deals. We're the AI\-native platform bridging the gap between revenue intelligence and sales training for scaling businesses – trusted by over 10,000 employees at leading companies.

**The Role**
 Join our engineering team as we build intelligent systems that power deal\-winning strategies for ambitious companies.
   

  

 You'll be working on challenging problems in sales intelligence: predicting deal outcomes, automatically surfacing actions that move deals forward, and turning sales data into strategic insights that drive revenue.
   

  

 In our fast\-paced environment, you'll take ownership of meaningful AI projects from day one, work closely with our founding team, and see your code impact real businesses within weeks.
   

  

**What You'll Be Building**
 AI Sales Intelligence:
   

  

* Develop AI agents that predict deal outcomes and identify revenue risks before they become problems
* Build intelligent coaching systems that automatically surface personalised next\-best\-actions for sales reps
* Build intelligent automation that helps sales teams execute their playbooks with unprecedented consistency
* Create advanced analytics engines that transform sales conversations into strategic insights


**Production\-Scale AI Infrastructure**
* Architect ML pipelines that process millions of sales interactions in real\-time
* Build robust data quality frameworks ensuring our AI insights are always accurate and actionable
* Implement RAG systems and vector search capabilities for intelligent content discovery and recommendation


**Scalable ML Operations**
* Deploy models using modern cloud infrastructure (AWS, Docker, Kubernetes) that scale with our rapidly growing customer base
* Build comprehensive evaluation pipelines ensuring our AI performs reliably in high\-stakes sales environments
* Create monitoring and alerting systems that keep our AI running smoothly 24/7


**The Impact You'll Make**
* Week 1\-4: Ship your first AI feature that helps sales reps close more deals
* Month 3: Utilise LLMs for processing of real sales data for major enterprise clients
* Month 6: Lead the development of a major AI capability that transforms how our customers win business
* Year 1: Become a key technical contributor shaping the future of sales AI


**Technical Excellence**
 What Makes You Perfect for This Role:
   

  

* Recent MSc/MEng in AI, Machine Learning, Computer Science, or related field with strong academic performance
* Hands\-on experience with Python
* Experience with LLMs and their APIs
* Experience building end\-to\-end ML systems from data processing to production deployment


**Additional**
* Hands\-on experience with PyTorch, transformers, and modern ML frameworks
* Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS preferred), Docker, Kubernetes, and MLOps practices


**Real\-World AI Experience**
* Previous internship or project experience applying GenAI, LLMs, and prompt engineering to solve business problems
* Experience with RAG systems, vector databases, and intelligent search capabilities
* Understanding of production ML challenges: data quality, model monitoring, and scalable deployment


**Sales \& Business Acumen**
* Genuine interest in understanding sales processes and revenue optimisation (we'll teach you the rest!)
* Strong analytical mindset with ability to translate business requirements into technical AI solutions
* Experience conducting user research or working directly with end\-users of AI systems


**Startup DNA**
* Thrive in fast\-paced environments where you can ship code that immediately impacts real businesses
* Self\-motivated and able to take ownership of complex technical challenges
* Growth mindset with eagerness to learn about sales, business strategy, and emerging AI technologies
* Collaborative team player who can work effectively with product, design, and go\-to\-market teams


**Why You'll Love Working Here**
 Strong Growth Opportunity:
   

  

* Work closely with our founding team and contribute to the technical direction of a scaling startup
* Take ownership of AI initiatives that directly impact our core product and customer success
* Accelerate your career in the growing field of revenue intelligence


**Modern Technology**
* Work with the latest advances in GenAI, LLMs, and production ML systems
* Access to quality infrastructure and comprehensive learning resources
* Mentorship from experienced engineers and exposure to enterprise\-scale challenges


**Direct Impact**
* Your work directly helps sales teams improve their performance and grow their businesses
* See the immediate impact of your contributions on real customers and their outcomes
* Contribute to building a leading platform for sales AI


**Amazing Benefits \& Culture**
* Competitive salary
* 25 days annual leave \+ bank holidays and your birthday off
* Life assurance (3x annual salary) and pension scheme
* Up to £900 flexible benefits: medical insurance, dental, gym membership, and more
* Be part of the Blenheim Chalcot family – connect with incredible people across 30\+ startups
* Regular social events and networking opportunities at Scale Space


**Our Values**
* Experts, but not always right \- We bring deep expertise while staying humble and open to new approaches
* Substance before "sizzle" \- We build robust, impactful AI that solves real problems, not just impressive demos
* Caring and courageous \- We support each other's growth and tackle the hardest technical challenges in sales AI
* Evergreen entrepreneurs \- We think like owners and continuously innovate to stay ahead
* We care deeply about giving feedback in the right way. We champion the idea of test and learn, and we’re not afraid of failure. We’re always looking for ways to improve, and respect everyone’s ideas. And we really take the time to invest in our working relationships, and overall, practise what we preach.


 This Role Might Not Be For You If...
   

  

* You prefer slow\-moving, bureaucratic environments (we ship fast and iterate quickly)
* You want to work on AI for AI's sake rather than solving real business problems
* You're not excited about learning the sales domain and working closely with go\-to\-market teams
* You're uncomfortable with the ambiguity and rapid change that comes with cutting\-edge AI development


**Join Our Team**
 We're looking for our next AI engineer to help build the future of revenue intelligence. If you're ready to apply your AI skills to solve challenging problems in sales and business growth, we want to hear from you.
   

  

**Right to Work:** 
 Please note that all candidates must have the right to work in the UK by the start of their employment. We are unable to sponsor a work visa for this role.
   

  

*We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. Hive Perform is committed to building an inclusive, diverse team where everyone can do their best work. We don't tolerate discrimination and actively work to create a supportive environment for all.*

description:
**The role**
**Join our team!**
 We are a market\-leading nature tech company on a mission to make nature measurable and actionable at scale. Our platform delivers vital insights on species, habitats, and nature\-related risks, helping businesses across sectors \- from mining and renewable to CGS and financial services \- make smarter, more sustainable decisions.
   

  

 As global leaders in biodiversity monitoring and eDNA analysis, we are transforming how nature is measured. Our technology makes biodiversity insights accessible, actionable, and scalable, powering change from conservation to industry. Recognised as Earthshot Prize Finalists 2024, BloombergNEF Pioneers 2024, World Economic Forum Technology Pioneers 2024, and part of the TechNation Future Fifty 2025, we are shaping the future of how organisations understand and protect nature.
   

  

 As we enter a new phase of rapid global growth, we are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Machine Learning (ML) and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Engineer to contribute to the development and deployment of our advanced ML and AI solutions. In this hands\-on role, you'll be involved in building innovative models and scalable infrastructure that tackle complex ecological and geospatial challenges. You'll play a key part in our ML and AI roadmap, directly contributing to helping organisations understand and manage their impact on nature.

* Feature development: Lead on the design, development and deployment of end\-to\-end ML and AI features, from research and prototyping to productionisation and monitoring.
* Model implementation: Implement advanced ML algorithms and models to solve complex ecological and geospatial problems.

 We’re looking for a driven and collaborative engineer who is passionate about using ML and AI to make a tangible impact on helping organisations understand and manage their impact on nature. You should thrive in a dynamic, purpose\-driven environment and be eager to tackle challenging, real\-world problems.
   

  

**What You'll Bring**
* 2\+ years of experience in ML engineering or applied data science.
* A proven track record of successfully contributing to the design, building and deployment of ML models into production environments.
* Expertise in Python and relevant ML libraries
* Experience with various ML algorithms (e.g. supervised, unsupervised, reinforcement learning) and deep learning frameworks (e.g. TensorFlow, PyTorch ).
* Experience developing generative AI applications and deploying them into production.
* Experience working with cloud platforms, ideally Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and BigQuery .
* Proficiency in working with and querying global scale datasets.
* Familiarity working with bioinformatics, life sciences or geospatial data.
* Understanding of software engineering best practices, including version control (e.g. Git), CI/CD, and testing.

* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to distil complex ideas for diverse audiences.
* A collaborative mindset and a desire to work cross\-functionally across a purpose\-driven business.

* Strong prior experience working with bioinformatics, life sciences or geospatial data in an ecological context.
* Experience working with software as a service (SaaS) products .


**What's In It For You**
* Competitive Salary
* Impactful work with a purpose\-driven team
* Flexible work arrangements \- this is a hybrid position, with the expectation that the successful applicant will attend the office 2\-3 days a week, depending on location
* Opportunities for professional growth
* Benefits package including salary sacrifice pension scheme prioritising sustainability; life assurance; Enhanced annual leave; Cycle to Work Scheme; enhanced family friendly policy; £250 L\&D budget to use on our Learning platform, Learnerbly.


**Why us?**
 At NatureMetrics diversity and inclusion are part of our DNA. Together, we continue to build an inclusive culture that encourages, supports, and celebrates the diverse voices of our employees. It fuels our innovation and connects us to the communities we work with. Our values leave no space for stereotypes. We are all unique and pull together for a common purpose.
   

  

 We're a dynamic team passionate about nature and biodiversity and we take immense pride in our work and our impact. Join us on this journey!

 Backed by ambitious investors, we're on a mission to make biodiversity measurable at scale to underpin global goals and accelerate finance into nature. NatureMetrics combines tech and AI to derive simple insights from the full complexity of nature on the ground.
   

  

 We're a dynamic team passionate about nature and biodiversity and we take immense pride in our work and our impact. Join us on this journey!

title: Data and AI Engineer- Defence
description:
Our customer is looking for a Data and AI Engineer in the defence sector.
   





 Role:
 



 Undertake stocktake of current AI initiatives across Engineering UK including assessment of customer tools and infrastructure already available to determine suitability of applications for executing Systems Engineering identified use\-cases.
   





 In doing so, ensure engagement of stakeholders involved in the following activities:
   





 · External paper / conference / internet assessment of use of AI in the context of Systems Engineering and MBSE specifically to determine if any other suitable tools currently not employed by the customer are available.
 



 · Undertake Proof of Concept investigations to perform the selected use cases. This will be the main activity and may involve exploitation of tools and infrastructure already within the customer, or may involve the testing of a third party tool. Use Cases are:
 



 · Using Generative AI to produce Design Verification Plans (DVPs)
 



 · AI Generated Reference Requirements
 



 · Identification of Challenging Customer and Project Requirements
 



 · Proof of concept activities include:
 



 · Define scope of engineering data \- expectation is to start with systems artefacts (Requirements, Test Results other supporting documentation as appropriate)
 



 · Scope engineering data model approach and capture mechanism in more detail
 



 · Undertake incremental definition, development and review of NLP Generative AI engineering data model as proof of concept, initially tailored to specific Systems Engineering use cases.
 



 · Ensure underlying data model compliance with customer IM and InfoSec policies.
 



 · Formalise, establish governance, deploy such that the proof of concept can be used practically to derive harmonisation and consistency into programmes in areas such as requirement definition and Verification \& Validation activities.
 



 · Data Model Conclusion/Review and Decision to proceed to full deployment
   





 Outputs:
 



 · Requirements (if external solution) or outline design solution (if internal solution) to be fulfilled by candidate AI solutions.
 



 · Down\-select decision review to determine most appropriate toolsets to employ to realise Systems Engineering Use Cases follow internal/external tool assessment.
 



 · Deployment plan and pilot project deployment strategy for implementation of a Generative AI solution using natural language processing (NLP).
 



 · Incremental delivery of engineering data model \- output at end of offload initial 6 month contract should cover systems engineering use cases as identified above.
 



 · Report to summarise delivery of the above \- Toolset Capability Assessment, Generative AI Requirements, Down\-select Justification, Summary of PoC data model design and deployment activities.
   

  





 COMPETITIVE RATES OUTSIDE IR\-35
   

  




**Requirements**

 Skills:
 



 · A strong understanding of the concepts, benefits, ontology, taxonomy and applications of AI.
 



 · Experience of exploring and deploying AI to support productivity improvements in the engineering domain would be an advantage.
 



 · Good experience of container management and orchestration platforms to deploy, scale and manage containerised applications is required. Direct experience of Rancher, Kubernetes or Docker would be beneficial.
 



 · Experience of data manipulation and visualisation techniques such as Power BI or Google Analytics' Looker Studio.
 



 · AI tool development skills are not necessary but some ability to code APIs to interact with Large Language Models using Python / R or other languages is required.
 



 · A strong engineering background, ideally with experience in systems engineering. Defence engineering experience is desirable.
 



 · Ability to work autonomously and comfortable with loosely defined packages of work with low levels of supervision.

**Summary:**  

Are you excited about building AI\-driven software that revolutionizes the way professionals work? Join a dynamic and highly skilled team at Thomson Reuters, where we combine the agility and innovation of a startup with the stability and resources of a global leader. As a Lead Product Engineer, you will play a pivotal role in developing AI\-powered systems that enhance accounting workflows through automation, intelligence, and seamless orchestration.  

  

**About the Role:**  

In this role as an AI Engineer, you will:  

**Innovate in a Startup\-Like Environment:** Be part of a fast\-moving, forward\-thinking group that is creating AI\-driven software for accounting professionals. You’ll work with top AI and software development experts, leveraging cutting\-edge technology to build intelligent and scalable systems. This role is for the CoCounsel for the Accounting team, formed from the recent acquisition of the startup Materia.  

**Collaborate Across Functions:** Work closely with AI/ML engineers, frontend developers, product managers, and designers to build robust services that support generative AI experiences. Help build out our core AI interfaces, including Conversations, Workspaces, Grid, and Knowledge Base.  

**Learn and Grow:** Ramp up with a mentor and a world\-class engineering team into software engineering best practices. You'll be expected to quickly transition into contributing independently and with high standards for quality, testing, and user experience.  

  

**About You:**  

You are a fit for the position of AI Engineer if your background includes:  

**Required Experience \& Skills:**

* You will graduate in Fall 2025 or Spring/Summer 2026 with a Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science or a related field.
* You have had 1 or more relevant internships, co\-ops, or other industry experience.
* Strong programming skills with at least one of Python or Typescript.
* Familiarity with AI\-assisted coding tools, such as Cursor, Claude Code, or Copilot.
* Demonstrated teamwork skills and communication skills, e.g., through group projects.
* Passion for AI\-driven software and new engineering paradigms.
* An adaptable, creative problem solver who enjoys exploring new technologies.
* Comfortable working in a fast\-paced, evolving environment.

 **Preferred Skills \& Experience:**

* Demonstrated project ownership experience via side projects, hackathons, etc.
* Experience building generative AI products, agent\-based architectures, or AI APIs from providers like OpenAI and Anthropic.
* Knowledge of vector databases, embeddings, or search\-based AI.
* Experience with our tech stack \- Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL, AWS, Vercel, Next.js/React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS

**Note:** Thomson Reuters is unable to provide sponsorship for this position now or in the future.  

  

\#LI\-SS

 **What’s in it For You?**

* **Hybrid Work Model:** We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment (2\-3 days a week in the office depending on the role) for our office\-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* **Flexibility \& Work\-Life Balance:** Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work\-life balance.
* **Career Development and Growth:** By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real\-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills\-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI\-enabled future.
* **Industry Competitive Benefits:** We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company\-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* **Culture:** Globally recognized, award\-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work\-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* **Social Impact:** Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro\-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* **Making a Real\-World Impact:** We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

 **About Us**


Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.


We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. At a time when objectivity, accuracy, fairness, and transparency are under attack, we consider it our duty to pursue them. Sound exciting? Join us and help shape the industries that move society forward.


As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. Thomson Reuters is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer providing a drug\-free workplace.


We also make reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and for sincerely held religious beliefs in accordance with applicable law. More information on requesting an accommodation here.


Learn more on how to protect yourself from fraudulent job postings here.


More information about Thomson Reuters can be found on thomsonreuters.com.

title: Manager, Machine Learning & AI
description:
What do you think of when you hear the name MNP? We are more than a prominent consulting firm in tax and accounting, we are redefining how organizations succeed in the digital age by bridging strategic vision, technical innovation, and operational execution to deliver transformative results.



Make an impact as we look to strengthen our Data \& AI team with a Manager, Machine Learning \& AI. The successful candidate would be a key contributor to our AI and machine learning initiatives. Reporting directly to the Director of AI and Machine Learning, you will serve as their strategic partner, or "wingman," driving the execution of AI projects, fostering business development, and ensuring alignment with enterprise objectives. The ideal candidate will have 5\-7\+ years of experience delivering AI projects, deep expertise in the Microsoft technology stack, and a proven track record in enterprise environments.



At MNP, you will work alongside a collaborative team of creative thinkers and problem\-solvers. You will gain hands\-on experience, tackle meaningful challenges, and grow your skills in an environment where your voice is valued, and your development is a priority. If you are ready to accelerate your career and make a lasting impact, this is where your journey begins.


**Responsibilities**


* **Project Delivery and Execution**:
	+ Lead the end\-to\-end delivery of AI and data projects, from ideation to deployment, ensuring high\-quality outcomes that meet business objectives.
	+ Collaborate with cross\-functional teams, including data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders, to design and implement AI solutions.
	+ Utilize the Microsoft technology stack (e.g., Azure AI, Azure Machine Learning, Power BI, Synapse Analytics) to architect and deploy scalable AI models and data pipelines.
* **Business Development**:
	+ Identify and pursue opportunities to expand AI and data initiatives, aligning with enterprise goals and client needs.
	+ Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders to drive adoption of AI solutions and secure buy\-in for new projects.
	+ Contribute to proposals, presentations, and strategic plans to showcase the value of AI\-driven transformation.
* **Strategic Partnership**:
	+ Act as a trusted partner to the Director of AI and Machine Learning, providing insights, recommendations, and operational support to advance the AI strategy.
	+ Monitor industry trends and emerging technologies to ensure the organization remains at the forefront of AI innovation.
* **Team Leadership and Collaboration**:
	+ Mentor and guide junior team members, fostering a culture of innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.
	+ Coordinate with other departments to ensure seamless integration of AI solutions into enterprise workflows.
* **Performance and Accountability**:
	+ Establish and track key performance indicators (KPIs) for AI projects to demonstrate measurable impact and ROI.
	+ Ensure compliance with data governance, security, and ethical AI standards in all projects.

**Skills and Experience**


* **Experience**:
	+ 5\-7\+ years of hands\-on experience delivering AI and data projects in enterprise environments.
	+ Proven success in managing complex AI initiatives, from proof\-of\-concept to production, with measurable outcomes.
	+ Demonstrated business development acumen, including experience in client engagement, proposal development, and stakeholder management.
* **Technical Expertise**:
	+ Deep proficiency in the Microsoft technology stack, including Azure AI, Azure Machine Learning, Power BI, Synapse Analytics, and related tools.
	+ Strong understanding of machine learning algorithms, data modeling, and data engineering principles.
	+ Experience with cloud\-based architectures and enterprise\-grade data platforms.
* **Enterprise Experience**:
	+ Extensive experience working in large\-scale enterprise environments, with a track record of delivering AI solutions that align with business objectives.
	+ Familiarity with enterprise challenges, such as data security, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
* **Soft Skills**:
	+ Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate complex technical concepts to non\-technical stakeholders.
	+ Strong leadership and collaboration skills, with a proven ability to work as a strategic partner to senior leadership.
	+ Analytical mindset with a focus on problem\-solving and delivering measurable results.
* **Education**:
	+ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Engineering, or a related field. Advanced degree (Master’s preferred).
* **Certifications** (Preferred):
	+ Relevant Microsoft Certifications (ie: Azure AI Engineer**)**
	+ Other relevant certifications in data science, machine learning, or project management (e.g., PMP, Six Sigma).

**MY REWARDS @ MNP**



With a focus on high\-potential earnings, MNP is proud to offer customized rewards that support our unique culture and a balanced lifestyle to thrive at work and outside of the office. You will be rewarded with generous base pay, vacation time, 4 paid personal days, a group pension plan with 4% matching, voluntary savings products, bonus programs, flexible benefits, mental health resources, exclusive access to perks and discounts, professional development assistance, MNP University, a flexible ‘Dress For Your Day’ environment, firm sponsored social events and more


**Diversity@MNP**



We embrace diversity as a core value and celebrate our differences. We believe each team member contributes unique gifts and amplifying their potential makes our business stronger. We encourage people with disabilities to apply!

 Makalu Health is an AI\-driven Physician and Provider sourcing platform that unifies fragmented clinician data to surface credential\-ready MDs and APPs faster than ever before.  We’re seeking a
 **Lead**

* Familiarity with LLM fine\-tuning, embeddings, RAG pipelines, and prompt engineering.
* Experience integrating AI into production systems at scale.
* Strong understanding of data engineering and data pipeline orchestration.
* Excellent problem\-solving skills, and the ability to move fast without breaking the product.



  





**Why Join:** 




  





 🚀 Early, high\-impact role with direct ownership of system design \& scaling.
 



 👉 Work directly with a second\-time founder who previously scaled a multi\-million dollar healthcare recruiting business before this in this space.
 



 💡 Opportunity to apply cutting\-edge AI/agent frameworks in production.
 



 🌍 Fully remote with competitive comp, equity, and long\-term growth upside.
 



 ✅ Backed, already working with health systems and growing fast.

 Senior AI Engineer

* Well\-versed in Agile/Scrum development processes.
* Excellent communication and problem\-solving skills. Degree in Computer Science, AI/ML, or a related field.
* Preferred/Desired Experience Experience working with Azure Machine Learning API and AWS Bedrock is a plus.
* Familiarity with LLMOps and deploying models in production environments. Understanding of data pipelines and distributed AI processing.


 Why Proofpoint
   

  

 Protecting people is at the heart of our award\-winning lineup of cybersecurity solutions, and the people who work here are the key to our success. We’re a customer\-focused and a driven\-to\-win organization with leading\-edge products. We are an inclusive, diverse, multinational company that believes in culture fit, but more importantly ‘culture\-add’, and we strongly encourage people from all walks of life to apply.
   

  

 We believe in hiring the best and the brightest to help cultivate our culture of collaboration and appreciation. Apply today and explore your future at Proofpoint!
   

  

 Why Proofpoint? At Proofpoint, we believe that an exceptional career experience includes a comprehensive compensation and benefits package. Here are just a few reasons you’ll love working with us
   

  

* Competitive compensation

* Flexible work environment \[Remote options, hybrid schedules, flexible hours, etc.].

 Our Culture
   

  

 Our culture is rooted in values that inspire belonging, empower purpose and drive success\-every day, for everyone.
